                                                                                                                                                                                                                        R  TC  B  700 - 201/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                M 1501 505 E-EN-2025-05


















































TECHNICAL DATA:
•                                        Bi-directionally acting, static storm brake for gantry
travel.
•                                        Max. holding force FH = 700 KN. It is generated by a
                                        wedge clamped between clamp wheel and crane rail.
•                                        Released by Eldro thruster.
•                                        Thruster with lowering valve and c-spring.                                                               INFORMATION:
•                                        With manual release lockable in released position.                                                       •                                        The crane can travel between 50mm and 90mm before
•                                        Field replaceable brake shoes.                                                                                                                   the rail brake is engaged.
•                                        Brake shoes hardened and on the area of support it is                                                    •                                        Nominal gap between rail and released brake shoe is
                                        carried out with sprockets.                                                                               14mm.
•                                        Limit switch for brake „released“.                                                                       •                                        Max. permissible deviation of rail height is +/- 8mm.
•                                        Limit switch for directional indication.                                                                 •                                        The rail brake is designed for installation under gantry
•                                        Weight approx. 1110 kg.                                                                                                                          travel cross-beam.
